what_changed: NCUA final rule, mostly as proposed in 2026-04761, clarifying the purpose of 12 CFR part 749, updating definitions and removing references to recommendations and guidance; effective July 16, 2026.
compliant_agent_must_now: Credit union clients' records preservation programs follow the revised part 749 from July 16, 2026; whether any retention period for loan or member-contact records changed is not stated in the abstract.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Do credit union clients' retention schedules for call recordings, disclosures or payment records cite the removed part 749 guidance?
rationale: Same subject as 2026-04761, now final. Relevance depends on whether the removed guidance set retention for records a servicing agent creates; the abstract does not say. Register gap: no row covers NCUA part 749. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
